text:
Type: white molded picture frame with mat
Use: displaying photos, prints or artwork on a wall or shelf; living room, bedroom, hallway, dining room
Style: classic, traditional, Scandinavian
Materials: molded frame in a smooth white painted finish, off-white mat board, clear glazing
Colors: white, warm off-white mat
Shape: upright rectangle with a stepped, rounded molding that gives a soft beveled edge, broad cream mat around the picture, medium-width profile, light visual weight
Feel: fresh, gentle, timeless
Goes with: pale walls, light wood, linen textiles, brass or silver accents; classic, farmhouse or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: VIRSERUM
product.description: The mount enhances the picture and makes framing easy.
